page.layout: One page of verse, running head top left in the left margin area; heading in capitals at top centre, subtitle beneath, then the poem in one block of lines; catchword "Labe" at lower right.

main_text.head: GVILLIELMVS ZIEGLERVS:
main_text.p: GErmen nobile, & arctiore vinclo Fida amicitiæ mihi ligate,
ZIEGLERE, allubet hic tibi applicare, Quæ rex maximus Israelis olim, Zelo percitus æstuante, voouit:

Iova æterne, benignitatis auctor, Si me lumine videris sereno: Cautus innocuæ studebo vitæ, Et, ut tota domus sit in tegella, Non exempla sequar scelestiorum, Sed horrebo operas scelestiorum, A me côrque nefarium exulabit: Non agnoscam ut amicum iniquiorem: Linguæ spicula qui jacit, propinqui In famam, exitio hunc putabo dignum: Qui supercilio efferatus omnes Temnit præse, hunc odio putabo dignum, Rursum lumina dirigam ad fideles; Grati mecum habitent ut inquilini: Is, qui vir probus est, demum suave Mihi servitium exhibebit: ullum Nec ferent mea tecta fraudulentum: Aut unquam bene habebit aut beate, Qui mendacia nonnisi loquetur: At quantocyus improbos repellam; Ut Iovæ semel exulent ab urbe Vnā omnes scelerum omnium ministri
O votum bene! o tibi peraptum;

page.notes: Printed heading "GVILLIELMVS ZIEGLERVS" and subtitle are in the top area; the verse text is set in roman with italic passages; "voouit" in the scan reads as "vovit" (printed form uncertain, possibly "voouit"). The word "Labe" at lower right is a catchword. The faint show-through text on the left margin (mirrored from the other side) is omitted. The initial "G" is a large woodcut-style initial joined to "Ermen".
